novels.title: Trash of the Count's Family
novels.alt: The Laws of the Hunt, Lout of the Count's Family, 백작가의 망나니가 되었다
novels.summary:
When I opened my eyes, I was inside a novel—a very familiar one.
The world was from The Birth of a Hero, a grand tale about Choi Han, a high schooler from Earth transported to a different dimension. His journey was destined to be one of heroics and triumph. My role? I wasn’t the hero, the villain, or even a sidekick. I became the Count’s no-good son—a lazy, entitled noble despised by everyone.
Which was perfect. Why? Because all I wanted was a peaceful, slacker life.
When Choi Han’s peaceful village is destroyed, he transforms into a brooding, unstoppable force of vengeance. My idiotic original self? He messes with Choi Han and gets turned into a punching bag. Determined to avoid that miserable fate, I make a single resolution: stay out of trouble, keep my head down, and live an easy life.
Except trouble keeps finding me. From accidentally gaining the attention of powerful heroes to being dragged into interdimensional chaos involving the sinister Hunter Families, I’m constantly forced to abandon my dream of lazing around in luxury.

novels.title: Entomologist In Sichuan Tang Clan
novels.alt: Fabre in Sichuan's Tang Family, 파브르 in 사천당가
novels.summary:
Spicy Fabre, a popular streamer with over a million subscribers and a reputation as an expert on poisons and venomous insects, faced an unexpected twist of fate. During a local shoot in Africa, he was bitten by a black mamba and met an untimely death—only to awaken in the Martial world.
Now, deep in the jungle, cultivating venomous insects, the streamer has drawn the attention of the Sichuan Tang Clan, famed for their mastery in poison arts, who wants him in their ranks.

novels.alt: Heavenly Demon Reborn!, Divine Astonishment, 신마경천기
novels.summary:
You emphasized harmony your whole life and this is how you go…!’ The successor of the Spear Master Sect and his apprentice Hyuk Woon Seong were framed of learning a forbidden Demonic art and slayed.
A helpless and pitiful death by the hypocrites of the Orthodox sect.
The moment Woon Seong faced his death, the artifact of the Spear Master Sect emitted light and gave him a new life.
But his objective is one. Vengeance! Accepting his destiny and remembering his grudge, Woon Seong trains in martial arts and his time of revenge slowly comes closer….
Take over the Demonic Cult and punish the hypocrites of the Orthodox Sect! The revenge story of Number 900, Woon Seong growing in tasks of life and death.

novels.title: Trash of the Count's Family
novels.alt: Lout of the Count's Family, LCF, 백작가의 망나니가 되었다
novels.summary:
[The Birth of a Hero] was a novel focused on the adventures of the main character, Choi Han, a high school boy who was transported to a different dimension from Earth, along with the birth of the numerous heroes of the continent.
I became a part of that novel as the trash of the Count’s family, the family that oversaw the territory where the first village that Choi Han visits is located.
The problem is that Choi Han becomes twisted after that village, and everyone in it, are destroyed by assassins. The bigger problem is the fact that this stupid trash who I’ve become doesn’t know about what happened in the village and messes with Choi Han, only to get beaten to a pulp.
“…This is going to be a problem.” I feel like something serious has happened to me. But it was worth trying to make this my new life.
